# Real-World Evaluation Fixture: Project Alpha

This fixture is copied, synthetic-realistic project data for read-only harness
evaluation. It is not connected to an external project checkout, issue tracker,
model provider, sandbox, or task runner.

The fixture contains one documentation-cleanup issue represented as:

- one project-level event stream
- one Stage 0-style task record bundle

Tests may read this directory only as inert fixture data.
